commands: echo 'Step 1: Check for any existing Node.js binaries'
which node || echo 'node not in PATH'
which npm || echo 'npm not in PATH'
echo 'Step 3: Check if dist was built somehow'
echo 'Step 4: Try to run server directly with system node if available'
echo 'Step 5: Check if we can start server without PM2'
nohup /usr/bin/node dist/server.js > server.log 2>&1 & echo 'Started with /usr/bin/node' || echo 'Failed to start with /usr/bin/node'
echo 'Step 6: Check what processes are running'
ps aux | grep node || echo 'No node processes'
ps aux | grep server || echo 'No server processes'
echo 'Step 7: Check server log if exists'
